The artificial intelligence that turns marketing into appointments, clients, and revenue

From the first ad to the appointment on the calendar

AURA helps you build and manage complete marketing campaigns, tailored to your goals, the services you want to promote, and your schedule's capacity.

It generates copy, images, videos, and promotional strategies, supporting you in publishing campaigns and managing the contacts you acquire. What AURA does for your business

📣

Creates advertising campaigns

AURA analyzes your goal and guides you in choosing the best strategy to promote facial and body treatments, hair removal, body-contouring programs, open days, and other commercial initiatives.

It can generate:

  • promotional strategies
  • offers and positioning
  • copy for Meta campaigns
  • images and creative content
  • cinematic-quality video ads
  • WhatsApp messages and follow-ups

You no longer start from a blank page. You start from a strategy.

⏱️

Manages new leads around the clock

Every lead can receive an immediate response, even outside business hours. AURA talks with the prospective client, answers frequently asked questions, presents the service, and gathers the information needed to understand their real interest.

🎯

Qualifies opportunities

Not every contact has the same needs. AURA asks targeted questions, identifies the treatment of interest, gathers availability, and guides the person through a simpler, more personalized decision path.

📅

Drives the client toward booking

AURA doesn't just provide information. Its goal is to guide the lead all the way to action: requesting a consultation, applying for an initiative, choosing a date, or booking an appointment.

🔄

Reactivates clients you've already acquired

Your database may hold hundreds of inactive clients. AURA can help you build personalized reactivation and remarketing campaigns, proposing new treatments and promotions aligned with each client's profile.

📈

Helps you sell more to active clients

AURA also supports upselling and cross-selling activities, suggesting complementary communications and offers to increase purchase frequency and the average value of each client.

One ecosystem, three core goals

Acquisition

Find new potential clients through advertising campaigns, content, and strategies designed to generate requests and appointments.

Retention

Keep the relationship with clients active, build follow-ups, and increase how often they return to your business.

Upselling

Offer treatments, programs, and additional services to people who have already chosen your business.

AURA does the work. You stay in control.

Artificial intelligence automates repetitive tasks, but you always define the goals, offers, budget, and priorities. You can monitor campaigns, review the leads generated, track how conversations are going, and step in whenever your team's support is needed.

AURA doesn't replace the human value of your business. It makes it more effective.
